stageLabel: Wasan gudu. Halittar tana gudu da kanta. Yi tsalle don ɗaukar ra'ayoyi masu kyau da kauce wa marasa kyau.
stageHow: Latsa Space, Enter, kibiyar sama ko W don tsalle. Latsa Escape don dakatarwa. Latsa Tab don ci gaba. Duk abin da ke wasan yana cikin jerin Karanta ba tare da wasa ba.

guideText: Ɗauki abin da ke cikin ƙa'idar web component. Tsallake abin da ba na asalin yanar gizo ba.
